speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning Martha. How have you been feeling since your last visit?

speaker: Patient
text: Good morning doctor. I've been feeling okay, but I had some mild tension headaches over the past weekend.

speaker: Doctor
text: Are you still taking your daily Atorvastatin 20 mg tablet?

speaker: Patient
text: Yes, every evening with dinner. I also stopped taking the Furosemide last month like you recommended.

speaker: Doctor
text: Excellent. For the respiratory symptoms, I am prescribing you Azithromycin 250 mg daily.

speaker: Patient
text: Thank you doctor. Just remember I had that bad rash from penicillin a few years ago.

speaker: Doctor
text: Yes, we have your penicillin allergy clearly noted in your chart, so we avoid beta-lactams.
